opening.argument: The presentation is framed as practical career guidance about IBM and employment decisions. It explicitly promises “an in-depth Review of IBM,” covering employees, workplace conditions, ratings, layoffs, and on-site opportunities, while the slides provide salary, joining-bonus, take-home-salary, bond-period, and employer-comparison information for freshers. Those details support evaluating employment options, not investment returns or requests to transfer money or data. The channel describes itself as helping with a “career journey,” and the promoted mock-interview and consultation services do not change the subject of the presentation. The available evidence does not establish deception, required payment, verified IBM affiliation, or a harmful outcome; it also records a stated money-back guarantee. The material therefore supports an educational and operational career-guidance purpose rather than a deceptive solicitation.
